conditional: 5 coarse samples across the same source interval; if input/control/new-result temporal candidates are absent or ambiguous, spend remaining 11 in largest pixel-change interval; otherwise stop
stop_scope: candidate temporal relationship completeness only; causal sufficiency stays unknown
event_grouping: same modality/key/control in consecutive inspected DOWN frames; any inspected UP/absent or changed target separates events; unsampled gaps are explicitly uncertain
graduation: at least two additional independently labeled input events recovered and higher total event recovery, no additional incorrect temporal candidates or false event extras, same caps; causal-sufficiency success scored separately, never inferred from temporal order
labels: independent visual labels frozen and hashed before observers; recorder telemetry withheld until visual labels freeze
constraints: no tuning frozen run after seeing scores
sampling_caveat: 16 requested output frames does not imply 16 internal codec frames decoded; internal decode work is unmeasured, not a matched decode claim
one_frame_caveat: 40ms requested hold is a brief-input intent, not verified single-native-frame visibility; label actual retained presentations
scoring: one-to-one event matching by modality/key and at least one retained requested timestamp within native visual interval plus/minus 40ms; control exact text and box IoU >= 0.5 scored independently; temporal pairs compared only after independent event/result mapping; duplicate event fragments are false extras
protocol_revision: wording clarification and scoring tolerance frozen before first observer execution; original capture-intent protocol hash preserved
scope: instrumented local browser UI with visible pressed color and input indicators, not arbitrary third-party footage
